candidate.source_summary: The pattern excludes files from the .extensions directory in the BUILD_DIR from being copied to the web deployment directory (WEBDIR). The .extensions directory contains custom application extensions that can control build pack behavior.
candidate.sink_summary: The filtering rule prevents .extensions directory contents from being deployed to the web-accessible WEBDIR, which would otherwise expose potentially sensitive extension files.
candidate.guard_summary: The where_name_does_not_match filter acts as a security control to exclude the .extensions directory from web deployment. This is part of a series of filters that also exclude .bp, .bp-config, manifest.yml, and LIBDIR.
candidate.risk_pattern: Application-provided extension files in .extensions directory are excluded from web deployment to prevent exposure of sensitive build-time extension code.
candidate.context_summary: The function creates a web directory if it doesn't exist, copying files from BUILD_DIR to WEBDIR while excluding sensitive directories including the newly added .extensions exclusion.
